name: @tol/domain
description: Entities, states, invariants, domain services (the spec). earlier: money/minor-units safety helpers and the RFQ/Quote/DealRoom/DealCondition state-transition graphs — 'Transitions happen through domain services, never arbitrary UI field edits' (the spec STATE RULE). Zero runtime dependencies, same discipline as @tol/authz (see its README) — apps/api's services call these BEFORE invoking @tol/db repositories, which stay persistence-thin.
